description: Complete mediation: no built-in tool executes on the host. Points at a committed script, not a built binary, so a plugin whose binaries are missing denies rather than failing open. PostToolUse carries two advisory host events, both watching failures that present as slow CI rather than as an outage: host free space (a full host kills the builder VM, never says "disk") and self-hosted runner capacity (an OOM-killed runner exits 0, so nothing restarts it and a third of CI vanishes silently).
